                queue.offer(i);

            totalDuration += durations.get(u);

import java.util.*;

class Solution {
    public static int solve(Map<String, Object> data) {
        List<Integer> durations = (List<Integer>) data.get("duration");
        List<List<Integer>> edges = (List<List<Integer>>) data.get("edges");
        
        if (durations == null || durations.isEmpty() || edges == null || edges.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        int n = durations.size();
        Map<Integer, Integer> startTimes = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Integer, Integer> endTimes = new HashMap<>();
        
        // Sort nodes based on their dependencies
        Arrays.sort(edges, Comparator.comparingInt(edge -> edge.get(0)));
        
        // Calculate start times
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            startTimes.put(i, 0);
        }
        
        for (List<Integer> edge : edges) {
            int u = edge.get(0);
            int v = edge.get(1);
            
            if (!startTimes.containsKey(v)) {
                return 0; // Circular dependency detected
            }
            
            startTimes.put(u, Math.max(startTimes.get(u), startTimes.get(v) + durations.get(v)));
        }
        
        // Calculate end times
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            endTimes.put(i, startTimes.get(i) + durations.get(i));
        }
        
        // Find the maximum end time
        int maxEndTime = 0;
        for (int endTime : endTimes.values()) {
            maxEndTime = Math.max(maxEndTime, endTime);
        }
        
        return maxEndTime;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(solve(new HashMap<>() {{
            put("duration", Arrays.asList(5));
            put("edges", new ArrayList<>());
        }})); // Expected output: 5
        
        System.out.println(solve(new HashMap<>() {{
            put("duration", Arrays.asList(3, 4, 5));
            put("edges", Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList(0, 1), Arrays.asList(1, 2)));
        }})); // Expected output: 12
        
        System.out.println(solve(new HashMap<>() {{
            put("duration", Arrays.asList(2, 5, 9));
            put("edges", Arrays.asList(Arrays.asList(0, 2), Arrays.asList(1, 2)));
        }})); // Expected output: 14
    }
}

Finally, it finds the maximum end time among all tasks to determine the earliest time they can all finish. If there is a circular dependency, the function returns 0.

        int[] durations = ((List<Integer>) data.get("duration")).stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
        List<List<Integer>> edges = (List<List<Integer>>) data.get("edges");
        
        if (durations.length == 0 || edges.isEmpty()) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Build a topological sort using Kahn's algorithm
        Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
        Map<Integer, Integer> indegree = new HashMap<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < durations.length; i++) {
            indegree.put(i, 0);
        }
        for (List<Integer> edge : edges) {
            indegree.put(edge.get(1), indegree.getOrDefault(edge.get(1), 0) + 1);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < durations.length; i++) {
            if (indegree.get(i) == 0) {
                queue.offer(i);
            }
        }
        
        int totalDuration = 0;
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            int current = queue.poll();
            totalDuration += durations[current];
            
            for (List<Integer> edge : edges) {
                if (edge.get(0) == current) {
                    indegree.put(edge.get(1), indegree.get(edge.get(1)) - 1);
                    if (indegree.get(edge.get(1)) == 0) {
                        queue.offer(edge.get(1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return totalDuration;
    }

                dfs(i, durations, edges, dp);
            }
        }

        int maxTime = 0;
        for (int time : dp) {
            maxTime = Math.max(maxTime, time);
        }

        return maxTime == -1 ? 0 : maxTime;
    }

    private static void dfs(int node, Map<Integer, Integer> durations, List<List<Integer>> edges, int[] dp) {
        if (dp[node] != -1) {
            return;
        }

        int duration = durations.get(node);
        dp[node] = duration;

        for (List<Integer> edge : edges) {
            if (edge.get(0) == node) {
                dfs(edge.get(1), durations, edges, dp);
                dp[node] += Math.max(0, dp[edge.get(1)] - duration);
